en.title: The City of Eternal Night and the Silver Mirror Waltz
en.premise: Luminaris, the sleepless city bathed in magical light where the sun never rises. Eliana, a noble daughter and the jewel of high society, hides her true self behind a perfect mask. But when she touches the 'Mirror of Truth' hidden within the forbidden archives, she glimpses the empire's cruelest secrets. It is there she encounters Julian, a disgraced youth from a fallen noble house. Amidst the rustle of silk and the fragrance of roses at a lavish ball, two souls embark on a perilous romance that will gamble their very destinies.

zh.title: 常夜之城与白银之镜舞曲
zh.premise: 鲁米纳里斯，一座在永恒之夜中由魔法灯火照亮的不夜城。贵族千金艾莉安娜作为社交界的璀璨之花，始终戴着一副完美的假面。然而，当她触碰到禁区中安置的“真理之镜”时，帝国的残酷秘密在她眼前揭开。在那里，她邂逅了被剥夺名誉的没落贵族青年朱利安。在丝绸裙裾的沙沙声与浓郁玫瑰香气交织的奢华舞会背后，两人坠入了赌上命运的危险之恋。
